before.title: Native continuity acceptance spine: ordinary launch, same process
before.description:
## Current architecture and delivery

Omux owns each adapted application's authentication contract and implementation. Use sufficient native extension mechanisms or an Omux-maintained adapter delivered through plugin/configuration, upstream contribution or explicitly maintained application modification. There is no vendor-provided Omux/Codex hook prerequisite. Experimental candidate proof does not establish unmodified Codex support.

Delivery order: install/activate → Chromium source connection → verified identity and usable authority → renewal → ordinary application integration → same-process handoff. Home Manager owns fleet packages/services/exact-ID host registration; Omux owns custody/enrollment. Development and release identities and namespaces remain isolated.

## This carrier

Whole native continuity acceptance: installation, source consent, verified identity/usable authority, renewal, ordinary native launch/resume and same-process handoff. Preserve native session/history/tools/approvals; never replay accepted streams or repeat tool execution.

Acceptance US-LAUNCH-01, US-ATTACH-01, US-HANDOFF-01, US-NOREPLAY-01, SC-01–11, NAC-018. Each phase requires exact version-bound successful evidence; timely safe refusals are separate outcomes. Restart, wrapper invocation, prepared fallback, route warming and synthetic tests cannot close seamless handoff.

Paths: docs/product/user-stories.md, support-and-completeness.md, docs/spec/native-adapter-contract.md and reliability contracts. Historical 0/11/82-pass score and v0.1.15 retain their recorded candidate/release truth. New source/build/portable staged CLI/refusal predicates close only their named scope, not whole product support. Current resumed checkpoint: ID-AUTHORITY, ID-CONTAINMENT, ID-CHANNEL, ID-SETUP and ID-DELIVERY pass within their stated experimental scope; six other sprint gates remain open. ef255a3e passed paired installed native-host registration/channel isolation and actual CLI/Qt/daemon custody/restart/replay. b62de355 passed local SPA unit/render/archive checks. 97e91470 reached actual Chromium but failed an assertion; browser consent, fleet activation, native resume, provider/live handoff, Darwin and achieved lifecycle SLO remain unproved. Workspace evidence paths (unpublished): docs/tracker-updates/integrated-delivery-installed-setup-2026-10-05.json, integrated-delivery-spa-2026-10-05.json and integrated-delivery-continuation-2026-10-05.json.

## Evidence and retained history

Require exact source/artifact/platform/application/provider tuple and declared locked Nix/Bazel action. Browser execution, service activation, native launch/resume, handoff and measured SLO achievement are separate gates. Builds/tests/refusals prove only stated predicates. Targets create no contractual SLA or staffed support promise. This description changes no issue state, date, assignee or dependency.

Authority: [AGENTS.md](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/AGENTS.md>), [architecture SSOT](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/docs/plans/omux-native-account-lifecycle-reset-2026-10-02.md>), [delivery plan](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/docs/plans/omux-integrated-delivery-sprint-2026-10-05.md>), product/user-stories.md, spec/native-adapter-contract.md and reliability/service-objectives.md.

Complete predecessor description and exact readbacks remain in [durable before snapshots](<https://github.com/Jesssullivan/oauth-mux/blob/codex/omux-native-reset/docs/tracker-updates/integrated-delivery-2026-10-05.json>) and [this issue's retained history/comments](<https://linear.app/tinyland/issue/TIN-2057>). Dated historical measurements/releases retain their original candidate/date scope. Current scope supersedes old operational dictates without erasing historical evidence.

## Current architecture and delivery

Omux owns each adapted application's authentication contract and implementation. Consent explains automatic enrollment of verified identities. Disconnect is context-specific and removes source-retained secrets while independent grants/native history retain their authority; browser disappearance detaches. Development/release extension ID, host, service, staging, socket, DB and vault stay disjoint.

Paths: extensions/, delivery/test_installed_browser.py, delivery/test_installed_chromium.py, nix/, src/instance.zig. TIN-2720 owns provider identity/fields; TIN-2063 setup; TIN-2830 whole installed product.

Current bounded evidence — resumed October 5: ef255a3e passed actual paired development/local-release-evaluation native-host registration, channel/socket/state/vault isolation and ownership-safe removal. Browser consent/recovery, service activation, provider enrollment and native/live continuity remain unproved. Earlier allocation refusal remains historical, not the current blocker.
